notes: v3.66.94: Dieu chinh / Quyet toan tren phieu Thanh toan (Phai tra + Chi ho) - Hoa don dieu chinh tang/giam hoac Quyet toan (gia tri quyet toan -> tu tinh chenh); moi lan la phieu rieng lien ket phieu goc, so DNTT rieng; nguoi lap goc hoac Ke toan tao (nguoi dung: du buoc nop KT -> KT -> KTT -> L2; KT tao: vao KTT -> L2); tang -> Cho thanh toan / Bang ke; giam da duyet -> tu can tru vao con phai tra cua phieu goc, phan vuot = tra thua: NCC hoan tien (ghi dich danh, So NH) hoac can tru phieu khac cung NCC; P/L phan chenh; chi ho: dong dieu chinh +-USD len bao cao chu tau; MH 04 phieu dieu chinh (ban dau / dieu chinh in dam / sau dieu chinh / da TT / con phai tra hoac tra thua); so theo doi, tong chi phi PO, tu ho so hien dieu chinh.
